description:
When economic data comes out: FRED's release calendar, including scheduled future dates.
With release_id, the next dates for that release (e.g. 50 = Employment Situation, 10 = CPI, 53 = GDP). Without it, every release between start_date and end_date (default: the next 14 days).

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default: 14 days out; no limit for one release)

name: fred_release_calendar
